brands.prompt: What is the best project management software?

facts.statement: The Team plan costs $12 per month.
Taskline integrates with Slack. It does not integrate with Salesforce.
Taskline serves customers in the United States and Canada only.
Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase.
Taskline was founded in 2016.
The Team plan includes 50 projects.

brands.prompt: What is the best customer support software?

facts.statement: The Growth plan costs $29 per month.
Brightdesk integrates with Shopify. It does not integrate with SAP.
Brightdesk serves customers in the UK and Ireland only.
Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase.
Brightdesk was founded in 2018.
The Growth plan includes 5 agents.

brands.prompt: What is the best small business accounting software?

facts.statement: The Plus plan costs $25 per month.
Ledgerly integrates with Stripe. It does not integrate with Oracle NetSuite.
Ledgerly serves customers in Australia and New Zealand only.
Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase.
Ledgerly was founded in 2013.
The Plus plan includes 3 users.

brands.prompt: What is the best coffee subscription?

facts.statement: The Monthly plan costs $18 per month.
Roastery Co integrates with Apple Pay. It does not integrate with PayPal.
Roastery Co serves customers in the United States only.
Refunds are available within 7 days of purchase.
Roastery Co was founded in 2019.
The Monthly plan includes 2 bags per delivery.
